integrity: Two exhaustive generators reconstruct the complete avoidance language through length 42 using independent suffix-only and whole-word factor scans; their complete levels agree exactly.
scientific_limitations: The scalar threshold N(10,4)=42 is prior work. The new claim is only the complete length-41 equality classification: exactly two extremizers, one complement orbit, both palindromes. No claim is made for other k.
title: Exactly two extremizers below the \(N(10,4)=42\) power-antipower boundary
